usages.explain:
■ Expresses a certain smell, but often conveys a negative connotation, like "smelling bad".
■ Also has the meaning "looking really like that". Often used in cases considered not very good.

examples.transcription: へやのなかがさかなくさい。

usages.mean:
- Smelly
- Full of smell, full of smell (State).

title: ～くさい => full of N / looks like N
